snippet.title: The Arcane Open - A Golf Deckbuilder Roguelike
snippet.description:
Here's your first look at The Arcane Open, a golf roguelike deckbuilder! 

Play cards to bend where your ball lands, build your deck between holes, meet strange folk on the walk, and take on the bosses waiting on the course. Wishlist now on Steam!

Please see below and on our channel for the link to the steam page and other socials! 

The Arcane Open on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5277960/The_Arcane_Open/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer
The Arcane Open on Discord: https://discord.gg/Z63F5JzvcM
The Arcane Open on X: https://x.com/thearcaneopen
The Arcane Open on Reddit: http://www.reddit.com/user/The_Arcane_Open/
Contact Us: thearcaneopen@gmail.com (an email link)
